title: Shift Bridge Notes — Sprint 12 (Mar 22, 2027)
body:
Shift Bridge Notes — Sprint 12 (week of Mar 22, 2027)

Owners / context
- Doc owner: Nora Patel (eng-site-reliability). Quick handover doc for overlapping shifts and oncall synthesis.
- Purpose: collect outstanding incidents, SLO posture, shift handoff items, and immediate action items for the next 48 hours. Informal — expect edits.

TL;DR
- Two small incidents this week; one regression in KV cache invalidation (partial traffic degradation, ~20m) and a sporadic autoscaler mis-fire causing transient queueing (several minutes) on dedicated pools. No customer-facing downtime.
- SLOs largely healthy, but tail latency for /v1/generate exceeded 99th-percentile target on Mar 19 (see INF-3421).
- Runbook gaps identified: cache invalidation troubleshooting steps are incomplete; autoscaler diagnostic checks need to be added.

Incidents this week
1) INC-2027-03-19 — KV cache partial invalidation (owner: Priya)
   - Symptom: small subset of dedicated hosts served stale KV prefixes after rolling deploy; results in higher token repeat and latency for ~3% of requests.
   - Impact: increased error-level inference outputs for certain long-context chats, customer-reported regressions (support tickets: CS-8192).
   - Root cause (working hypothesis): deploy hook that trims last-epoch cache entries ran before new kernel loaded; race condition.
   - Current status: mitigated with a rolling restart and temporary sticky routing to known-good hosts. Follow-up: INF-3421 created for durable fix and test harness (linked).

2) INF-3487 — Dedicated autoscaler mis-fire causing short queueing spike (owner: Mateo)
   - Symptom: autoscaler removed a burst node prematurely when ephemeral metric threshold was crossed during a GC pause window. Queue depth spiked for ~4 minutes in region-us-west2.
   - Impact: increased 95/99 latency for 3-minute window, no request timeouts.
   - Mitigation: disabled aggressive scale-down policy until we patch the heuristic to include GC-safe markers.
   - Follow-up: add GC/eviction signals to scaler logic; add canary that simulates GC pause to autoscaler tests (INF-3487).

SLO snapshot (as of 2027-03-22 07:00 UTC) - Hosted API /v1/generate: 99.94% (30d rolling) — target 99.95% (borderline). 99th pct spike on Mar 19 accounted for majority of shortfall.
- Dedicated pools: Request success 99.99% (30d) — within goal. Latency P95 slightly elevated in us-west2 during autoscaler event.
- Embeddings endpoint: 99.998% — healthy.
Notes: A targeted 48-hour remediation window for the /v1/generate tail latency has been authorized; focus on autoscaling and cache race fixes.

On-call handoffs & shift notes (shifts overlapping Mar 21–22) - Night shift (Mar 21 23:00–Mar 22 07:00 UTC): Liam oncall; saw first alert for KV cache; applied sticky routing; created INC-2027-03-19.
- Morning shift (Mar 22 07:00–15:00 UTC): Nora oncall; validated mitigations, escalated to eng-runtime.
- Afternoon shift (Mar 22 15:00–23:00 UTC): Priya slated; main tasks: verify INF-3421 test harness checkins and observe dedicated autoscaler after disabling scale-down policy.
Handoff checklist performed
- Active incidents annotated in Jira? — yes.
- Open customer tickets linked? — yes, CS-8192 & CS-8205.
- Runbook owner notified? — yes (SRE runbook rotation).

Action items & ownership (short-term)
- Nora: run a targeted replay of impacted KV cache scenarios using archived logs (due: 2027-03-23).
- Priya: complete INF-3421 patch + unit tests for cache invalidation ordering; add pre-deploy validation step (due: 2027-03-25).
- Mateo: prototype GC-aware scaler heuristic and add a synthetic GC pause canary to autoscaler CI (due: 2027-03-29).
- Liam: tidy alert thresholds for queue-depth alarms to avoid noise during scheduled GC windows (due: 2027-03-24).
- Sofia: update customer-facing incident summary draft for CS to review (due: 2027-03-23).

Runbook & playbook updates needed
- Cache invalidation runbook: add explicit sequence of steps to verify cache eviction ordering, with example queries and debug flags. Marked for immediate PR (owner: Priya).
- Autoscaler troubleshooting playbook: add section on interpreting pool GC indicators and manual scale-up override steps. Also add steps for re-enabling scale-down safely.
- Postmortem template: ensure it captures model-quality impact (token repeat rate) in addition to availability metrics.

Observations / heuristics from shifts
- We keep seeing brief tail-latency spikes correlated with background GC on some GPU hosts. Not all hosts show this — likely kernel / driver scheduling differences.
- Metric fidelity: current exporter rollup for queue depth samples at 30s granularity; consider adding 5s sampling for queue depth for better spike detection. (trade-off: storage/ingestion).
- Sticky routing helped reduce surface area but hides the underlying regression — ensure mitigation is paired with a short window of diagnostic logging to capture the bad behavior.

Open questions / decisions to escalate
- Do we accept extra cardinality (5s queue depth sampling) in metrics for the premium supported clusters? (proposal: enable for dedicated pools for 2 weeks).
- Should scale-down policy default be more conservative for dedicated workloads with active live customers? (proposal: conservative for first 24h after deploy).

Post-shift checklist for next oncall
- Verify INF-3421 PR status and CI results.
- Confirm autoscaler scale-down toggle remains disabled and monitor for false positives.
- Run the KV cache replay and snapshot token-repeat metrics; attach to the Jira.
- Ping the platform-eng channel once runbook PR is merged.

Notes to self / informal
- Reminder: when disabling a scale policy, add a TTL so we don't leave it disabled accidentally.
- Quick observation: the token-repeat metric (tokens/reply where repeated subsequence >3) is a useful signal — add it to the 1h incident watch dashboard.
- Put a short blurb in next SRE weekly about measuring model-quality signals (Nora).

Appendix: useful links & references - INC-2027-03-19: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2027-03-19
- INF-3421 (KV cache ordering): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
- INF-3487 (Autoscaler GC heuristic): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3487
- GitHub PR (debugging tool): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1987

End of notes — edit freely, please add observations from your shift in the top section.
